scripts.build: npm run build:io && npm run build:pages && npm run build:games
scripts.build:games: cd corpan/games/hover-runner && npm run build && cd ../../.. && npm run package:games && npm run copy:games
scripts.package:games: cd corpan/games/hover-runner && zip -r hover-runner.zip manifest.json dist/
scripts.copy:games: mkdir -p web/io/out/corpan/games/hover-runner && cp corpan/games/hover-runner/manifest.json web/io/out/corpan/games/hover-runner/ && cp -R corpan/games/hover-runner/dist web/io/out/corpan/games/hover-runner/ && cp corpan/games/hover-runner/hover-runner.zip web/io/out/corpan/games/
